attached.description:
Joins neighboring actions at their inner edges. Buttons share the first
button's variant and use its size when the group has no explicit size.
Use for a closely related set of actions or for a split button.

label.description:
Required accessible name for the group or toolbar (for example, "Text formatting").
Provide a localized name that describes the actions' shared purpose.

size.description:
Applies one token-backed size to each button while it belongs to the group.
Omit it to keep individual sizes in spaced mode.

toolbar.description:
Gives the group toolbar semantics, a framed surface and one Tab stop.
Horizontal arrows, Home and End move between the toolbar's actions.

--ki-button-group-attached-radius.description: Radius of the logical corners along a shared button edge.

--ki-button-group-backdrop-filter.description: Complete optional backdrop filter for the toolbar surface.

--ki-button-group-bg-image.description: Optional decorative image over the toolbar surface.

--ki-button-group-border-width.description: Thickness of the toolbar frame and divider.

--ki-button-group-divider-size.description: Block size of a vertical toolbar separator.

--ki-button-group-fg.description: Default toolbar foreground on its raised surface.

--ki-button-group-gap.description: Gap between actions in a spaced group.

--ki-button-group-padding.description: Toolbar frame inset and divider margin.

--ki-button-group-radius.description: Logical outside radius of the toolbar frame.

--ki-button-group-seam-overlap.description: Shared-edge overlap between adjacent attached actions.

component.description: Arranges related actions as a spaced group, attached group, or keyboard toolbar.

slots.description:
Related ki-button and ki-icon-button controls, in reading order.
Wrap labeled icon actions in ki-tooltip with the same label to show the
label on focus and hover. A toolbar can also include vertical separators.
